Cats & Soup: Magic Recipe is officially out now! ✨
The purr-fectly awaited official sequel to Cats & Soup has finally arrived!

To celebrate the official launch, we're gifting everyone two limited cats: the sweet Calico Latte cat and the lovely Cherry Blossom Shorthair! 🐱🌸

Embark on a magical merge adventure with adorable kitties today!🐾

Merge ingredients to whip up magical recipes, and decorate a cozy Share House for your feline friends!

Come and see what's new in the world of Magic Recipe!

We have some additional news for the 1.1.1 update:
- The Quilt Making event has been added. Come and stitch yours into a precious memory!
- The new Kitty Summer Life Sticker Book is now available!
- A new Daily Login has started, and cool rewards await!
- A new Draw is now available for you to meet special friends to spend the summer with!
- Granny Sheep has some new clothes for you to check out!
